title: Crafting mod
description: mod with crafting and portal crafting
body:
Do you like crafting? No? Then you have a problem. Download this mod and your life will be better!

Portals, sticks, and whatever your heart desires can be found in this mod!
- Portal crafting
- Portal crafting activator
- Crafting activator you can activate the portal
  
Portal will take you to a world almost entirely made of crafting
